summary:
SpaceBody is an interactive, web-based 3D exploration platform designed to make human biology and the effects of space exploration easier to understand. The project addresses the challenge of communicating complex scientific information about the human body in space through an engaging and accessible digital experience.

We developed a 3D Bio-Explorer that provides a visual approach to exploring human biology and understanding the relationship between the human body and the space environment. By presenting scientific concepts through interactive 3D visualization, SpaceBody aims to make space-related biological knowledge more engaging and understandable for students, educators, and space enthusiasts.

This project is important because understanding how humans interact with the space environment is essential for future space exploration, astronaut well-being, and scientific education. SpaceBody helps bridge the gap between complex scientific knowledge and public understanding through interactive technology.
details:
SpaceBody: The Astronaut Health Explorer

SpaceBody is an interactive, web-based 3D Bio-Explorer that helps people understand how the human body responds to the challenges of spaceflight. It combines 3D visualization with research-based scientific information to make complex space biology concepts easier to explore and understand.

How It Works:
Users can explore a three-dimensional representation of the human body and discover scientific information about the effects of spaceflight on different biological systems. The project draws on space biology research, including NASA's Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), the NASA Twins Study, and NASA Human Research Program resources. Research topics include bone health, cardiovascular changes, and immune-system responses during spaceflight. The information is presented through structured research findings rather than live astronaut telemetry.

Benefits and Intended Impact:
SpaceBody makes scientific knowledge more accessible to students, educators, researchers, and space enthusiasts. It encourages interactive learning, improves public understanding of human spaceflight, and raises awareness of the biological challenges astronauts face during long-duration missions. Its long-term goal is to support science education and inspire interest in space exploration.

Technology and Tools:

  • Programming Language: JavaScript
  • Frontend: React
  • 3D Graphics: Three.js
  • 3D Integration: React Three Fiber
  • 3D Utilities: Drei
  • Deployment and Hosting: Vercel
  • Hardware: Standard computer and modern web browser; no specialized scientific hardware is required to use the platform.

Creativity and Design Considerations:
The creative aspect of SpaceBody is its combination of interactive 3D technology and real scientific research. Instead of relying entirely on traditional text-based explanations, it uses visual exploration to communicate complex biological concepts. Our design considerations included scientific credibility, accessibility, user experience, responsive performance, and making research understandable without oversimplifying scientific findings.

SpaceBody aims to bridge the gap between space science research and public understanding through an engaging, accessible, and interactive digital experience.
